metadata.description: List of API endpoints to monitor

properties.description: Average response time exceeding performance target.

allOf.query:
[concat('requests
                                        | where name has ''Modality/''
                                        | summarize 
                                            totalRequests = count(), avgDuration = avg(duration)
                                            by name, cloud_RoleName, bin(timestamp, 5m)
                                        | where totalRequests >= 5')]

[concat('requests
                                        | where name has ''Modality/''
                                        | extend statusCode = toint(resultCode)
                                        | summarize 
                                            totalRequests = count(), systemErrors = todouble(countif(statusCode > 499))
                                            by name, bin(timestamp, 5m)
                                        | where totalRequests >= 5
                                        | extend FailureRate = round((systemErrors / totalRequests) * 100, 3)
                                        | extend Reliability = 100 - FailureRate
                                        | project timestamp, name, Reliability, systemErrors, totalRequests')]

[concat('requests
                                        | where name has ''Modality/''
                                        | extend statusCode = toint(resultCode)
                                        | summarize 
                                            totalRequests = count(), systemErrors = todouble(countif(statusCode > 499))
                                            by name, cloud_RoleName, bin(timestamp, 5m)
                                        | where totalRequests >= 5
                                        | extend FailureRate = round((systemErrors / totalRequests) * 100, 3)
                                        | extend Reliability = 100 - FailureRate
                                        | project timestamp, name, Reliability, systemErrors, totalRequests, cloud_RoleName')]

[concat('requests
                                        | where name has ''Modality/''
                                        | extend statusCode = toint(resultCode)
                                        | summarize 
                                            totalRequests = count(), systemErrors = todouble(countif(statusCode > 499))
                                            by name, cloud_RoleName, bin(timestamp, 5m)
                                        | where totalRequests >= 5
                                        | extend FailureRate = round((systemErrors / totalRequests) * 100, 3)
                                        | extend Reliability = 100 - FailureRate
                                        | project timestamp, name, Reliability, systemErrors, totalRequests, cloud_RoleName')]

[concat('requests
                                        | where name has ''Modality/''
                                        | extend statusCode = toint(resultCode)
                                        | summarize 
                                            totalRequests = count(), systemErrors = todouble(countif(statusCode > 399 and statusCode < 500))
                                            by name, bin(timestamp, 5m)
                                        | where totalRequests >= 5
                                        | extend FailureRate = round((systemErrors / totalRequests) * 100, 3)
                                        | extend Usability = 100 - FailureRate
                                        | project timestamp, name, Usability, systemErrors, totalRequests')]

[concat('requests
                                        | where name has ''Modality/''

                                        | summarize 
                                            totalRequests = count(), systemErrors = todouble(countif(statusCode > 399 and statusCode < 500))
                                            by name, bin(timestamp, 5m)

                                        | extend FailureRate = round((systemErrors / totalRequests) * 100, 3)
